name: Nursing home fines and harm citations by county: CMS penalties, actual-harm, immediate-jeopardy and abuse citations
description: For every US county with a Medicare- or Medicaid-certified nursing home, every state and territory, and the US: how many certified nursing homes and beds there are, how many times the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) fined them in the last three years and for how many dollars, how often and for how many days it denied payment, and how many health citations inspectors wrote at the actual-harm level or worse (scope and severity G to L), at the immediate-jeopardy level (J to L) and under the abuse, neglect and exploitation tags (F600 to F610), plus the share of rated homes with one star overall. Built each month from the four CMS Provider Data Catalog files behind Care Compare. Counts only: no facility names, addresses or certification numbers, and no resident data (CMS publishes none).
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Nursing home fines and harm citations by county: CMS penalties, actual-harm, immediate-jeopardy and abuse citations (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116048

distribution.name: nursing-homes.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: nursing-homes.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: nursing-homes-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in nursing-homes-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to nursing-homes.csv on id.

recordSet.name: nursing-homes
recordSet.description: The records of Nursing home fines and harm citations by county: CMS penalties, actual-harm, immediate-jeopardy and abuse citations, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or US for the national record

field.name: jurisdictionName
field.description: State or territory name

field.name: level
field.description: county, state or us

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Same as fines_total_usd

field.name: unit
field.description: What value measures

field.name: facilities
field.description: Medicare- or Medicaid-certified nursing homes in the CMS Provider Information file

field.name: certified_beds
field.description: Certified beds in those homes

field.name: rated_facilities
field.description: Homes with a CMS overall star rating

field.name: one_star_facilities
field.description: Homes rated one star overall (the lowest)

field.name: abuse_icon_facilities
field.description: Homes CMS marks with its abuse icon on Care Compare

field.name: fines_count
field.description: Fines (civil money penalties) CMS lists in the last three years

field.name: fines_total_usd
field.description: Dollars of those fines, as CMS lists them (before any later reduction CMS has not yet posted)

field.name: facilities_fined
field.description: Homes with at least one fine

field.name: payment_denials
field.description: Denials of payment for new admissions in the last three years

field.name: payment_denial_days
field.description: Total length of those payment denials, in days

field.name: citations_total
field.description: Health citations (deficiencies) in the inspections CMS publishes for each home

field.name: citations_harm
field.description: Citations at scope and severity G to L: actual harm or immediate jeopardy

field.name: citations_ij
field.description: Citations at scope and severity J to L: immediate jeopardy to resident health or safety

field.name: citations_abuse
field.description: Citations under federal tags F600 to F610 (abuse, neglect, exploitation, misappropriation and how homes prevent, report and investigate them)

field.name: facilities_with_harm
field.description: Homes with at least one citation at G to L

field.name: facilities_with_ij
field.description: Homes with at least one citation at J to L

field.name: penalty_from
field.description: Earliest penalty date in the CMS Penalties file

field.name: penalty_to
field.description: Latest penalty date in the CMS Penalties file

field.name: survey_from
field.description: Earliest inspection date in the CMS Health Deficiencies file

field.name: survey_to
field.description: Latest inspection date in the CMS Health Deficiencies file

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: The CMS files the record is built from

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Links to those files

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
